```{r}
library(foreign)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
```

# Making the sf binding box

```{r}
fishMasterLong <- read_csv("fishMasterLong.csv")

# Convert your data frame to sf points
pts <- st_as_sf(fishMasterLong, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

# Bounding box polygon
range_poly <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(pts))

# Expand the box by X degrees (e.g., 0.5 degrees)
bigger_box <- st_buffer(range_poly, dist = 0.5)

#creating test_shape for download of global fish watch data specifically
test_shape <- st_sf(geometry = bigger_box)
```

#Trying to read in all files in my shipping folder

#Combining them all

```{r}
files <- list.files("Shipping Raw Data/Dec",
                    pattern = "\\.dbf$", full.names = TRUE)

bbox <- st_bbox(test_shape)

data_combined <- lapply(seq_along(files), function(i) {
  cat("Reading file", i, "of", length(files), "\n")
  
  df <- read.dbf(files[i])
  
  df |>
    filter(LON >= bbox["xmin"], LON <= bbox["xmax"],
           LAT >= bbox["ymin"], LAT <= bbox["ymax"])
}) |> bind_rows()
```
## Cleaning post-downloaded Data so it's less huge!
### Gameplan: Add year_month column, sum # of instances of a vessel at each lat/lon for each year_month

```{r}
#Adding year_month
#CHANGE THE FIRST DF NAME FOR THE MONTH YOU'RE ON
Dec <- data_combined |>
  mutate(
    ts_chr = trimws(as.character(TIMESTAMP)),
    
    # If timestamp has no time, append " 00:00:00"
    ts_fixed = if_else(
      grepl("^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$", ts_chr), #no spaces between 1,2, which is important!!
      paste0(ts_chr, " 00:00:00"),
      ts_chr
    ),
    
    parsed_time = dmy_hms(ts_fixed),
    
    year_month = sprintf("%04d_%02d", year(parsed_time), month(parsed_time))
  )
```

```{r}
#rounding lat/lon
#CHANGE DATA NAME HERE
Dec$longitude <- round(Dec$LON, 1)
Dec$latitude <- round(Dec$LAT, 1)
```

```{r}
#making it counts instead of the whole shebang
#CHANGE DATA NAME HERE
Dec <- Dec |>
  group_by(longitude, latitude, year_month) |>
  summarise(ship_count = n(), .groups = "drop")
```


```{r}
#saving it
#CHANGE DATA NAME HERE
write.csv(Dec, "shippingdec.csv")
```
